body.statement: The sharp same-size realization frontier has rate \(r_N=N^{-1}\): for every \(N\ge4\), \(1/(46080N)\le\Delta_N\le\min\{1/4,3456/N\}\). There is no arithmetic exceptional subsequence for this asymptotic order. Moreover, \(\Delta_2=0\).
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it identifies the finite-population price of the fractional causal variance relaxation up to universal constants.
body.gap: Gao, Ge, and Qian (2025) target the fractional multi-marginal optimum, while the closest empirical Monge papers establish existence or counterexamples without a same-size minimax rate.
body.consumer: The rate determines when fractional multi-arm variance bounds can be treated as operationally sharp for a fixed trial population.
body.proof_tex:
For every \(N\ge4\), thm:constructive-rounding-upper and def:worst-gap give
\[
 \Delta_N\le\min\left\{\frac14,\frac{3456}{N}\right\}.
\]
The schedule in thm:explicit-matching-lower is one member of the same scalar class \([0,1]^{3\times N}\), so the supremum in def:worst-gap also satisfies
\[
 \Delta_N\ge\frac1{46080N}.
\]
Both inequalities hold for every integer \(N\ge4\), not merely on a replication subsequence.  Thus \(r_N=N^{-1}\), \(a=1/46080\), and \(b=3456\) certify the sharp asymptotic order and exclude an arithmetic exceptional subsequence for that order.

For \(N=2\), write the two transformed values in arm \(a\) as \(m_a-d_a\) and \(m_a+d_a\), with \(d_a\ge0\).  Any coupling is a law of \(S=(S_1,S_2,S_3)\in\{-1,1\}^3\) satisfying \(\mathbb P(S_a=1)=\mathbb P(S_a=-1)=1/2\); if \(d_a=0\), split the constant atom evenly between its two immaterial sign labels.  Its cost is
\[
 \mathbb E\left[\left(M+\sum_ad_aS_a\right)^2\right]
 =M^2+\mathbb E\left[\left(\sum_ad_aS_a\right)^2\right],
 \qquad M=\sum_am_a,
\]
because every \(S_a\) has mean zero.  Replacing the law by its antipodal symmetrization leaves these marginals and this even objective unchanged.  Every antipodally symmetric law is a convex combination of the four uniform laws on pairs \(\{s,-s\}\).  A linear objective over this simplex is minimized by one such pair, and that pair is exactly a realizable two-row schedule.  Hence \(V_{\mathrm{rel}}(F)=V_{\mathrm{int}}(F)\) for every two-row marginal triple, so \(\Delta_2=0\).
